name: ASMR Video
summary: A soft, close picture with a mic near the subject. Slow hands tap, brush and whisper. The look is dim, warm and quiet, with almost no text, because sound carries the work.

philosophy.core_thesis: Slow the image to match the sound: a calm frame, a soft light and a close mic make the viewer relax.
design_principles: Light the scene at 2700K to 3200K with one soft lamp and keep highlights under 85% white.
Place the subject within 30cm of the lens and keep the background out of focus at f/2 or wider.
Move at half speed: one action in each 4s to 8s, with no sudden cuts.
Hold each shot for at least 8s and cross-fade at 1s to 2s when a cut is needed.
Use a muted grade with lifted blacks (#1A1614) and no pure white.
Keep text to a title of 24px at 70% opacity for the first 3s; add no captions.
Show both stereo sides with a left and a right object, 1m apart, so the viewer sees the sound move.
anti_patterns: Busy backgrounds with many small details

layout.grid_mechanics: A 16:9 frame with a centre stage of 50% width and a wide soft margin; objects sit left and right at one third of the width.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 50% to 65% of the frame is soft, dark and empty; the spacing scale is 12, 24, 48 and 96px.
layout.alignment_rules: The subject stays centred and slightly below the middle; the title aligns bottom-centre at 48px from the edge.
layout.container_geometry: Large round shapes: 24px radius cards, circle masks and an oval vignette; no hard rule lines.

font_pairings.note: A soft, round pair that stays quiet on screen.
A warm serif pair for a title with a text face.
A round display face with a calm text face.

hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: light (300) and regular (400).
Set titles in lower case at 70% opacity.
Keep one type size in each frame.

color.palette_structure: Warm dark browns and rose with a candle amber and a pale cream; low saturation on all colours.
color.contrast_rules: Cream text on the dim room holds at least 12:1; rose and amber carry small marks and rules, not long text.
color.surface_treatment: Soft vignette gradients from the centre; a 3% film grain; no hard edges.
color.light_and_shadow: One warm lamp from the front-left; shadows are long and soft; glow on highlights at 12px blur.

materiality.surface_simulation: Soft fabric, wood, glass and skin in shallow focus, with a warm tone and a little grain.
materiality.border_rules: No visible borders; a 1px line at 15% opacity at most.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Background blur of 24px to 40px; cards float with a 32px soft shadow at 25% black.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline icons at 24px with a 1.5px stroke and round terminals, used only for play and volume.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Real objects in shallow focus: brushes, wooden tapping blocks, a microphone ball and a candle.

motion.transition_physics: Every move takes 800ms to 1.6s; fades take 1s to 2s; there is no bounce and no sudden cut.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises a card by 2px and brightens it by 6% over 600ms; active state dims it by 6%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels calm, sleepy and safe, with a light physical tingle.

avoid_when: The page needs speed, urgency or sales pressure.
The audience watches on a mute feed.
The content has no close, tactile subject.

modifiers.how: Raise saturation, add outlined captions and cut every 1.5s.
Light the scene at 5600K, use a pale table and add part labels.
Use a pastel ground, a soft avatar at the centre and a light mic icon.

pack.why: A thin outline family with round terminals matches the soft, quiet frame.

ground.why: The ground is a dim room lit by one warm lamp, and the vignette keeps the eye on the subject.
